[{"position": "Chief Executive Officer", "location": "India", "employmentType": "Self-employed", "workplaceType": "Hybrid", "companyName": "Aerozef Creations", "companyLinkedinUrl": "https://www.linkedin.com/company/aerozef-creations/", "companyId": "72644601", "duration": "7 yrs 4 mos", "description": "After my time as a Lead Website and Graphic Designer at Techmatrick, I decided to collaborate with Aerozef to turn my entrepreneurial dreams into reality. Today, I proudly serve as the CEO of Aerozef Creations. It may sound easy when I share it, but building a successful IT firm was no easy feat. It required relentless hard work, late nights, and dedication. I poured everything into this venture, and now, Aerozef is stable and thriving.

During the COVID-19 pandemic, my partner and I worked from home, constantly pushing ourselves to meet client needs. I clearly remember the struggles—sometimes working from dawn until late at night—just to ensure our clients were satisfied. Our workdays started at 6 a.m., followed by a quick lunch break at 2 p.m., and then we’d resume work until 9 p.m. The grind didn’t stop there; I also managed sales and lead management, working late into the night to close deals and ensure project completion.
